description: For the quadratic cubic-frame slice with alpha nonzero, q=beta/alpha^2 is a complete invariant under arbitrary polynomial source-target equivalence and stabilization; the alpha=0 line is gauge-equivalent to the base map.

members.statement: For every n at least two, the cubic-frame construction contains a (2n-3)-dimensional family of pairwise stably inequivalent generic-degree-three Keller maps of ordinary degree 4n+3. In particular, ordinary degree fifteen contains a three-dimensional stable-moduli family, modulo a finite involution.
